profile.description: A'Saffa Foods SAOG manufactures and distributes poultry meat in Oman. It offers fresh, frozen, and processed chicken products; and vegetables and fruit products. The company was formerly known as ASaffa Poultry Farms SAOG and changed its name to A'Saffa Foods SAOG in April 2010. A'Saffa Foods SAOG was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Ruwi, Oman.
